figurative_meaning_en: untimely or at an inopportune moment
example_sentences_in_bangla: বেটাইমে ফোন করো না, আমি ব্যস্ত আছি।
example_sentences_in_english: Don't call at a bad time, I'm busy.
This turned out to be an untimely task.
note: This idiom appears to be a Bengali adaptation or borrowing from English 'betimes' or similar, used colloquially for poor timing.
